actors.name: alice
actors.description: Belongs to team-a. Owns note-a1 and issued share token tok-a1 for it.

resources.name: note-a1
resources.description: Owned by alice, belongs to team-a.

resources.name: note-b1
resources.description: Owned by bob, belongs to team-b.

resources.name: tok-a1
resources.description: A share token alice issued for note-a1.

boundaries.trigger: alice shares a note and hands out the token
boundaries.description: Holding a share token is meant to grant access only to the specific note it was issued for.
Team membership is meant to scope which notes a user can list or read.

flows.name: View a note via share link

steps.details: Returns the note the token was issued for

edgeCases: No check that the requester was the intended recipient

flows.name: List a team's notes

steps.details: Returns all notes belonging to teamId

edgeCases: asUser is not verified against teamId before returning data

steps.details: Returns the note only if asUser is its owner

relatedBoundaries: No share token -> Has share token
Outside a team -> Inside a team

assumptions.statement: A share token only grants access to the note it was issued for
A user can only list notes for teams they belong to
A user can only view another user's note directly if they own it
